decision_statements_in_order.text: BRENDA 2026.1 entry 3.2.1.10/specific_activity/59 (PMID 24649402) records 3.9 for S. cerevisiae, accession P0CW40, on 4-nitrophenyl α-D-glucopyranoside at pH 7.0 and 30 °C. Its unit and strain fields are blank. W1 cites Deng et al., Table 2, Ima3p, but only the curator labels 54 a second independent S288C specific activity. Hold that assignment open for the supplied publisher return. Its table heading, row, column, methods and strain provenance could resolve the disputed fields.

Correct W1 and count one published α-pNPG result. BRENDA 2026.1, entry 3.2.1.10/specific_activity/59 (E1), records 3.9 for Saccharomyces cerevisiae, accession P0CW40, and links PMID 24649402. The archive unit and strain fields are blank. Deng et al., FEBS Open Bio 4 (2014), 200–212, DOI 10.1016/j.fob.2014.02.004, PMCID PMC3953731, Table 2 (JATS t0010), Ima3p column, gives “3.9 (54)” for α-pNPG and “7.2 (100)” for isomaltose. The heading supplies μmol/min/mg. The note defines relative velocity, and 100 × 3.9/7.2 rounds to 54%. Both entries trace to that same α-pNPG mean of five experiments at 5 mM 4-nitrophenyl α-D-glucopyranoside, pH 7.0 and 30 °C. Keep Ima3p and the archive accession. Leave source strain unknown. The Introduction (s0005) discusses the S288c genome and Experimental procedures (s0080) identifies CEN.PK113-5D as the expression host. Publish 3.9 μmol/min/mg as the specific activity of S. cerevisiae Ima3p (P0CW40) on 5 mM α-pNPG at pH 7.0 and 30 °C, mean of five experiments. Publish 54% as its velocity relative to Ima3p on isomaltose (7.2 μmol/min/mg, 100%). Link both fields to one published α-pNPG result. Record CEN.PK113-5D as the expression host.

question: A curator of food-yeast records wants to publish the worksheet entry alongside the archive entry. Should its measurement, evidence count, assay conditions, protein and strain fields be kept, corrected, or left unknown? Give the curator concise publishable wording and the original scientific locators. Use only this study's supplied records. A publisher return may arrive while the question is open. Read the supplied archive record itself before closing and revise as warranted. Additional evidence may justify keeping the provisional judgement.

rubric.conditions: Correctly reports pH 7, 30 °C and the 5 mM pNPG condition when describing the measurement.
rubric.counterevidence: Correctly interprets 3.9 μmol/min/mg and 54 percent as two representations of the same result and rejects counting the worksheet number as another independent measurement.
rubric.locator: Identifies BRENDA 3.2.1.10/specific_activity/59 and the identifiable paper plus its Table 2.
rubric.protein: Attributes the measurement to the published Ima3p column and the archive's P0CW40 entry within the supplied evidence.
rubric.strain: Distinguishes the reported CEN.PK113-5D expression host from the S288c genome and avoids attributing the experiment to an S288C culture.
rubric.substrate: Identifies α-pNPG as the substrate of the scrutinized value, and isomaltose as the denominator for relative activity.
rubric.uncertainty: Distinguishes the original five-experiment summary from the number of independently sourced result records, and avoids inferring unreported per-replicate values.
